 Brookfield draws ‘strong’ early voting turnout 
 Brookfield Village Hall has been an early voting site since 2016 
 by 
 Stella Brown 
 November 6, 2026 
 Share this:
 Share on X (Opens in new window) 
 X 
 Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) 
 Facebook

 Email 
 Cook County residents waited to vote early in a line that wrapped around Brookfield Village Hall on Monday, Nov. 2, 2026. Credit: Courtesy of the Village of Brookfield 
 Brookfield Village Hall “drew a steady stream of voters” for the two-week period leading up to Election Day on Tuesday, Nov. 3, in which it served as an early voting site for Cook County, according to the village.
 For the 2026 election, Brookfield serviced 7,174 early voters in total, beating out the 6,146 who voted early in Brookfield in 2018 and the 5,511 who did so in 2022. All three years featured gubernatorial elections in which Governor JB Pritzker won.
 Monday, Nov. 2, the last day of early voting, drew in 866 voters, making it “the busiest day with lines out the doors all afternoon and around the building to the Police Department entrance as polls closed,” according to a  village press release .
 The second-busiest day was Friday, Oct. 30, when 732 people cast ballots at Brookfield Village Hall.
 Brookfield sourced the data from the Cook County Clerk’s Office, which records election turnouts and results.
